slides.title: What do you want to leave behind you here?

body.text: This is a hand fight that locks him.

items: Whoever first locks his hands around his partner's head, body, or leg wins. The same rule applies to both players.

body.text: This is getting around the legs.

items: The top player wins by touching his shin to one side of the bottom player's body, then going around and touching the other side.
The bottom player wins by making the top player fall on his butt, then getting his own back off the mat.

body.text: This is building a lock from behind, slowly.

items: The top player wins by touching the bottom player's back with his palm, then locking his own wrist into his other elbow.
The bottom player wins when his back touches the mat.
